contract: External courier COD receivable and shipping payable confirm on delivered, remain until settlement. Cash driver has custody; bank/card collection has zero driver custody. No real business writes or activation.
findings: Current production source already implements these recognition rules.
Driver completion requires an explicit payment choice for outstanding amounts; missing/ambiguous evidence is flagged rather than assumed.
Noncash driver choice does not automatically create bank cash in operational accounting; existing tests explicitly enforce this.
Source collection excludes orders created at/before operational start; legacy or in-flight orders at start need separate reconciliation, not automatic import.
changes: Regression asserting no confirmed courier amounts before delivery, both sides on delivery without transfer, and refresh idempotency.
Payment-choice contract coverage for cash, bank transfer and card terminal.
verification: Full retained local Mongo acceptance running; no database deletion.
